dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I ask for more detailed information?

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: Absolutely. Simply speak with our boss, Blyushko.

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: I only work here, so I couldn't tell you much about where these things come from...

dialogues.speaker: Yevlena
dialogues.text: But I'm sure there are some things here of... unknown provenance. When I came to interview for this job, the boss had me repeatedly affirm that I had no relatives serving in the Druzhna before letting me in.
